transmute.enchantment_fusion.prismarine_: Rapidly chisels prismarine, sea lanterns, and ocean monument blocks.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.guardian_wa: Reduces harm from aquatic foes and chills wet attackers.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.heavy_plumm: Slightly slows normal swings, but falling strikes scale dramatically with drop height.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.heavy_slug_: Heavier projectiles drop faster and slam targets with kinetic bonus damage.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.anvil_stomp: Sinks rapidly in water and converts fall landings into an AoE ground-stomp shockwave.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.hard_breach: Deals bonus armor-piercing damage to armored or blocking foes, but over-penetrates unarmored targets.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.shell_crack: Cracks reinforced shells, bricks, and hardened blocks faster.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.pogo_gale_s: Airborne hits trigger an upward wind-burst bounce for aerial pogo combos; inactive underwater.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.wind_charge: Arrows detonate a non-griefing wind burst on impact; inactive underwater.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.gale_shield: Blocking unleashes a gust that launches melee attackers away; inactive underwater.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.ocean_bount: Slaying foes in water or rain yields bonus prismarine crystals, shards, and sea spoils.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.sand_pannin: Pans bonus nuggets and sea treasures when digging sand, gravel, and clay.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.sea_luck_au: Bestows periodic Luck while wading through water or rain.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.lure_hook_a: Tugs struck targets toward you like an angled hook and draws their focus.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.taunt_blade: Forces struck monsters to focus their aggro squarely on you.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.shepherd_lu: Gently coaxes nearby passive farm animals to wander toward you.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.monster_bea: Draws nearby monsters out of hiding toward your position for farming.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.sticky_root: Cursed grip: refuses to stay dropped while its owner lives, returning to your hand, yet roots struck enemies in place!
transmute.enchantment_fusion.unbreaking_: Inscribed on a Totem of Undying: grants a low 10% / 18% / 25% chance to survive fatal damage without shattering the totem!
Inscribed on consumables or throwables: grants a chance not to consume the item upon use.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.mending_xp_: Inscribed on an empty Glass Bottle: absorbs gained XP in your inventory and condenses into a Bottle o' Enchanting!
transmute.enchantment_fusion.mending_rep: Inscribed on consumables or throwables: absorbs gained XP over time to replenish +1 stack count.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.mending_vit: Inscribed on a Totem of Undying: channels absorbed XP directly into restoring your health.
